app.name: Super Mario Bros.
app.long_description: Bowser's forces have overrun the Mushroom Kingdom and captured Princess Toadstool. Guide Mario through the worlds, overcome enemies and hazards, and rescue the Princess. Wii Remote held sideways: D-Pad moves, 1 runs, 2 jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Classic Controller or Pro: D-Pad moves, B or Y runs, A jumps, + is NES Start, - is NES Select, HOME returns to the Homebrew Channel menu. Place smb.nes in the SD card root.
